content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy offer rented infrastructure. They handle payments, product delivery, and customer data—but only if you’re in an approved country. Sovereign commerce stacks, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197), deploy self-owned infrastructure. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store, Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and NOWPayments processes crypto payments. You own every component. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. Lifetime access.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries. PayPal suspends accounts in restricted regions without warning. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy require Stripe or PayPal integration, inheriting their restrictions. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. They use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for storage. Payment processing is on-chain via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC. Your store operates anywhere—no platform approval required.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction. Gumroad adds another 8.5% on top. PayPal can hold funds for months. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments, which charges 0.5% per transaction. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep fees under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, triggering automatic product delivery. No platform fees. No fund holds. You keep 99.5% of revenue. The only cost is the one-time stack deployment fee.
Platforms rent you infrastructure. Sovereign stacks let you own it.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, payment history, and product delivery process. They can suspend your account or change terms anytime. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Your store runs on your GitHub or Cloudflare account. Order data lives in your Supabase database. Files deliver from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is built into the stack—payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery. No platform can shut you down. No terms can change without your consent.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-supported country and value convenience over ownership, conventional platforms might work—until they don’t. For creators in restricted regions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a fully operational store in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, email security configured, and end-to-end testing. It’s built for creators selling presets, ebooks, courses, or software who need infrastructure they own, not rent.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the best alternative. It uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase to host, manage, and deliver your digital products. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and instant confirmation. This architecture gives you full ownership and bypasses platform restrictions entirely.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—95% less than Stripe or PayPal.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
